verdict.rationale: Genie Code is documented as a built-in workspace assistant that can run as an autonomous agent: it plans, runs code, fixes errors, and asks for approval before using tools. It also generates code, builds pipelines and AI/BI dashboards, debugs errors, and can run multiple chats in parallel, which is clear task delegation inside the product. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the agentic delegation quality.
